title: adnaria incana
intro: Adnaria incana, commonly known as Khas or White Khas, is a type of plant that belongs to the genus Adnaria, a group of flowering plants native to the Himalayan region. The plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Adnaria incana include its anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties, which help to reduce pain, fever, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities.
